name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faced a barrage of questions about the war with Iran from lawmakers on Tuesday, as the administration seeks more money for the escalating conflict.

changes.title: Sen. Patty Murray, D-Wash., on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's Senate testimony
changes.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Democratic Sen. Patty Murray of Washington about the administration's Iran war objectives following the testimony of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

changes.title: Trump threatens to attack Iran's infrastructure over Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: President Trump in a social media post threatened to attack Iran's infrastructure if the Iranian military shoots at ships in the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News' Natalie Brand and Charlie D'Agata have more.

changes.title: Iran’s Neighbors Long for a Deal, Any Deal, to End the War
changes.summary: Business owners in Pakistan are getting impatient for a chance to finally trade goods and oil along their long shared border with Iran.

changes.title: Send your questions for Richard Engel on the war with Iran and more
changes.summary: The United States is about to enter its fifth month of war with Iran, and NBC News’ chief foreign correspondent Richard Engel has been covering all the developments.

changes.title: Oil surges past $95 as U.S. downplays Iran diplomacy and 2nd key trade route is disrupted
changes.summary: The price of oil surged nearly 5% Wednesday as U.S. officials talked down new peace talks. Major disruptions now face two of the world’s key supply routes.

changes.title: Trump escalates threats on Iran as he attends dignified transfer of fallen soldiers
changes.summary: NBC News correspondents Monica Alba, Courtney Kube and Julie Tsirkin report on recent developments regarding the war with Iran as President Trump attends the dignified transfer of four soldiers killed in the Middle East. NBC News Intelligence Reporter Dan De Luce reports on President Trump’s approval of a deal with Sau.

changes.title: US House passes $1.15tn defense policy bill in near party-line vote
changes.summary: Passage of annual bill complicated by Trump’s decision to join Israel in attacking Iran without congressional approval The US House of Representatives passed a $1.15tn defense policy bill in a near-party-line vote on Wednesday, after Democrats refused to back the measure amid the war with Iran and Donald Trump ’s push.

changes.title: See How Houthis Put the Red Sea at Risk as an Alternative Oil Route
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has diverted huge amounts of oil to the Red Sea since the Iran war began, but now the Iranian-backed Houthi militants say that they intend to block that route.

changes.title: Speaking for Fallen Soldiers, Trump Says They Supported the Iran War
changes.summary: President Trump attended a dignified transfer for the soldiers as Americans were growing increasingly critical of the war.
